import pandas as pd

# File paths for all source CSVs
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_3/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_3/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_3/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_3/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_3/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_3/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_3/training_6.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_3/training_7.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_3/training_8.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_3/training_9.csv",
]

# Read all source files into a list of DataFrames
dfs = []
for file in source_files:
    # index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column as per instructions
    df = pd.read_csv(file, index_col=0)
    dfs.append(df)

# Concatenate all source DataFrames (UNION)
union_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Select only the columns needed for the target
# Target schema: ['company_permalink': string, 'funded_year': integer, 'raised_amount_usd': integer]
# The source columns have these names exactly.

# Convert raised_amount_usd to numeric (float), then fill NaN with 0, then convert to int
union_df['raised_amount_usd'] = pd.to_numeric(union_df['raised_amount_usd'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

# Convert funded_year to numeric (float), then fill NaN with 0, then convert to int
union_df['funded_year'] = pd.to_numeric(union_df['funded_year'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

# Group by company_permalink and funded_year, sum raised_amount_usd
grouped = union_df.groupby(['company_permalink', 'funded_year'], as_index=False)['raised_amount_usd'].sum()

# Ensure the types are correct as per target schema
grouped['company_permalink'] = grouped['company_permalink'].astype(str)
grouped['funded_year'] = grouped['funded_year'].astype(int)
grouped['raised_amount_usd'] = grouped['raised_amount_usd'].astype(int)

# Write the result to the target path
grouped.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_3/target_multisource.csv", index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read all source CSV files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_3/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_3/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_3/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_3/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_3/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_3/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_3/training_6.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_3/training_7.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_3/training_8.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_3/training_9.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_3/training_10.csv"
]

dfs = [pd.read_csv(f, index_col=0) for f in source_files]

# UNION all source tables (concatenate)
df_union = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Convert funded_year to integer (some sources have float or string)
# Coerce errors to NaN and then drop rows with NaN in funded_year or company_permalink or raised_amount_usd
df_union['funded_year'] = pd.to_numeric(df_union['funded_year'], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')

# Drop rows with missing critical columns to avoid aggregation errors
df_union = df_union.dropna(subset=['company_permalink', 'funded_year', 'raised_amount_usd'])

# Convert raised_amount_usd to numeric (float), then to int after aggregation
df_union['raised_amount_usd'] = pd.to_numeric(df_union['raised_amount_usd'], errors='coerce')
df_union = df_union.dropna(subset=['raised_amount_usd'])

# Group by company_permalink and funded_year, sum raised_amount_usd
df_grouped = df_union.groupby(['company_permalink', 'funded_year'], as_index=False)['raised_amount_usd'].sum()

# Convert raised_amount_usd to integer as in target schema
df_grouped['raised_amount_usd'] = df_grouped['raised_amount_usd'].astype(int)

# Convert funded_year to int (from Int64 nullable)
df_grouped['funded_year'] = df_grouped['funded_year'].astype(int)

# Write to target CSV with exact column names
df_grouped.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_3/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
